title: Incidence of Fat Embolism With Computer Assisted Total Knee Arthroplasty
brief_summary: The study to determine the if the incidence of Fat Embolism is decreased using Computer Assisted technology when performing a Total Knee Arthroplasty.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Must be a candidate for Computer Assisted Total Knee Arthroplasty

Exclusion Criteria:

* Mentally incompetent patients excluded
study_population: Patients who are deemed candidates for Computer Assisted Total Knee Arthroplasty
